summary_en: Interim dividend raised to 32 yen per share from 27.50 yen, effective December 7, 2026. Full-year dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027 revised upward to 64 yen per share, with year-end dividend increased to 32 yen from 27.50 yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Interim Dividend and Revision of Full-Year Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Mimaki Engineering announced an interim dividend increase on November 6, 2026. The interim dividend for the fiscal year ending March 2027, with a record date of September 30, 2026, was raised to 32.00 yen per share from the previously forecast 27.50 yen, representing a 4.50 yen increase. The payment is scheduled to become effective on December 7, 2026, with a total dividend amount of 927 million yen.

Simultaneously, the company revised its full-year dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027. The year-end dividend was increased from the previously forecast 27.50 yen to 32.00 yen per share, also a 4.50 yen increase. As a result, the full-year dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 2027 was raised to 64.00 yen per share from the previous forecast of 55.00 yen.

The company stated that the dividend increase reflects its basic policy of returning earnings to shareholders in a stable and continuous manner commensurate with business performance growth, and was determined after comprehensive consideration of revised consolidated financial forecasts announced on the same date. The company intends to allocate retained earnings toward preparation for future business development and strengthening of the financial foundation for sustainable growth.
